notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Yellow chevrons with burgundy-red arrows, a combination used nowhere else in the world.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Elaborate pedestrian crossings painted blue, with hanging signs above.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: Short white plates with blue lettering, unlike the longer, strip-bearing plates of most of Europe.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A 739 m rocky mountain with three towers on top dominates the view almost everywhere.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Smooth farmed hills with many small winding roads and lush Mediterranean vegetation.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Road signs and bollards match the neighbouring country's; many signs point to nearby Rimini.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Utility poles are mostly round concrete, with some wooden ones too.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Lime-green rubbish bins are especially common; some newer coverage shows black ones instead.

notes.subject: guardrail
notes.text: The only divided road runs from the border village of Dogana up to the capital, with a metal guardrail between lanes.
